meta.title: Privacy policy — Silk Road Tech
meta.description: What personal data Silk Road Tech collects, why it is needed, how long it is kept and how to request its deletion. Policy of SilkRoadTech LLP.
meta.ogDescription: What data we collect, why, and how we handle it.

strings.Silk Road Tech уважает конфиденциальност: Silk Road Tech respects the privacy of its visitors and processes only the data a user voluntarily provides through the contact form or the company's communication channels.
strings.Мы можем собирать ваше имя, фамилию, ном: We may collect your first name, last name, phone number, Telegram username, email address and the contents of your message. This data is used solely to reply to your enquiry, estimate the project and continue business communication.
strings.Мы не продаём и не передаём персональные: We do not sell or share personal data with third parties, except for the services used to process enquiries and maintain communication — for example, Formspree or corporate email.
strings.Если вы хотите просмотреть, обновить или: If you would like to review, update or delete data you have sent us, write to
strings.Продолжая использовать сайт и отправляя: By continuing to use the site and submitting the form, you agree to this privacy policy.
